name: Hammer of Thunderbolts

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Hurl (Thunderbolt)
powers.text: Spend 1 charge and throw it (20/60 ft). On a hit, the target and everything within 30 ft of it make a DC 17 Con save or are Stunned until the end of your next turn. It lands by the target, to be picked up again.

summary: +1 maul. With a Belt of Giant Strength and Gauntlets of Ogre Power: Strength +4 (to 30), Giant's Bane, and thunderbolt throws.
text: This magic weapon grants +1 to attack and damage rolls. Giant's Bane: attuning to it requires that you wear both a Belt of Giant Strength (of any kind) and Gauntlets of Ogre Power. As long as you're attuned and holding it, add 4 to your Strength score; this can push it past 20 but never above 30. A 20 rolled on an attack roll against a Giant with this hammer forces the Giant to pass a Constitution saving throw (DC 17) or die. Thunderbolt (5 charges): while attuned, spend 1 charge to hurl the hammer as a ranged weapon attack, treating it as having the Thrown property (normal range 20 feet, long range 60 feet). On a hit, it releases a thunderclap that can be heard 300 feet away, and the target and every other creature in a 30-foot radius around it must pass a Constitution saving throw (DC 17) or suffer the Stunned condition until your next turn ends. Each dawn, 1d4 + 1 spent charges return.
